name: Illusionist

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: Master of illusion: silent, longer-range illusions, phantasmal summons and illusions made real.

feature.name: Illusion Savant
feature.summary: Add two Illusion spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free.
feature.text: Choose two Wizard spells from the Illusion school, each level 2 or lower, and add them to your spellbook for free. Whenever you gain a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one more Illusion Wizard spell of a level you can cast for free.

feature.name: Improved Illusions
feature.summary: Illusion spells need no Verbal component and reach 60 feet farther; you know Minor Illusion and can cast it as a Bonus Action.
feature.text: You can cast Illusion spells without Verbal components, and an Illusion spell with a range of 10 feet or more gains 60 feet of range. You know Minor Illusion (if you already do, learn another Wizard cantrip); you can create both a sound and an image with one casting and cast it as a Bonus Action.

feature.name: Phantasmal Creatures
feature.summary: Summon Beast and Summon Fey always prepared and castable as Illusions, once free per Long Rest at half HP.

feature.name: Illusory Self
feature.summary: Reaction: an attack against you automatically misses; once per rest or spend a level 2+ slot.

feature.name: Illusory Reality
feature.summary: Make one nonmagical object in your illusion real for 1 minute.
